title: Online All the Time
blurb: Cracked screens, 2am wiki holes and replying "lol" without laughing.

prompts: dropped my phone in the toilet
typed "how to" into Google and been mortified by the autofill
shouted at a voice assistant that got it wrong
used the wrong emoji and made things awkward
ignored a software update for months
believed a fake prize message for at least five seconds
had so many browser tabs open I couldn't read the titles
used "forgot password" every single time I logged in
fixed a problem by turning it off and on again
watched a how-to video at double speed and still not understood
liked my own post and then hurriedly undone it
replied with a thumbs up to something that needed a real answer
let my phone sit at 1% all day for the thrill
taken forty photos to get one good one
missed ten calls because my phone was on silent
asked a friend to take down a photo I looked awful in
ordered something online at 3am
had a notification go off loudly in a silent room
walked into a pole while looking at my phone
fallen down a Wikipedia hole at 2am and learnt about something I'll never need
muted a group chat the second it got busy
cried at a video of an animal
used an embarrassing email address or username as a teenager
cleared my search history in a panic
sent a screenshot of a chat to the very person it was about
needed someone to say my name three times before I looked up from my phone
followed a stranger's pet account more closely than most of my friends
refreshed a loading bar like it would help
bought something because an influencer swore by it and regretted it
posted a "no filter" photo that had a filter
asked a stranger at a cafe if I could borrow their charger
lost something important because I never backed it up
scrolled back through my old posts and cringed
gotten stuck with a video call filter I couldn't switch off
let thousands of emails go unread and called it inbox peace
given up on a QR code menu and asked for a paper one
downloaded an app, used it once and kept it for years
posted a meme and checked the like count every few minutes
signed up for a free trial and forgotten to cancel
crashed the family Wi-Fi by streaming and been blamed
replied "lol" without having laughed at all
changed my profile picture just so one particular person would see it
watched an unboxing video for something I will never buy
Googled a symptom and decided I had three weeks left
drafted a reply, decided it was too late to send, and left it sitting there for a week
turned my phone over on the table so I wouldn't see who was calling
set up a new account just to start fresh and then abandoned it within days
